content:
The **South Mountain Lookout** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A man named Dave took refuge in the tower at some point with his dog, Rufus. Rufus was eventually taken and Dave left, swearing revenge upon those who took him. [1] 

This ranger lookout is situated on a cliff and has a good view of the surrounding area. At its base is a small shed with some junk items on a couple of shelves. The stairs leading up to the top of the tower are booby-trapped. A map in the top of the tower has a knife placed in it near where the Lucky Hole Mine is located.

The South Mountain lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.
